name: Register the editor's host functions over lantern:::editorbackend
body: `tools/generate-host-functions.py` reads `apps/world-editor/src/EditorHost.cpp`'s `RegisterFunction` calls and writes `src/EditorFunctions.nox`: the same 104 `editor*` functions, with the same signatures, each calling `lantern:::editorbackend`. `main.nox` adds the preview's two. Rerun the script after `EditorHost.cpp` changes.
